title: The normalized finite Cartier-cycle predicate
statement: For l,Y,hY as in the positive finite Cartier class, an ordinary strict reduction presentation D, a strict root system H with roots identification, and xi:Ext²(D.E(diagonalIntegralSource),H), FiniteCartierNormalization means exactly diagonalFiniteCycleNormalization with the positive finite source and root objects, DiagonalSourceNormalization for the source, the prescribed root comparison for the target, and finiteCartierClass(l,Y,hY,n) for the finite class at n. This is the identical finite-cycle clause of IsDiagonalLimit, named for sharing the expensive type.

def FiniteCartierNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems l (diagonalSurface Y))]
    (D : DiagonalReductionPresentation l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (H : DiagonalSystems l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (roots : H ⋙ diagonalForget l (diagonalSurface Y) ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower (diagonalSurface Y) l (Fact.out : l.Prime))
    (xi : Ext (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) H 2)
    : Prop
